about_the_game:
Throw elbows. Catch beats. Cause chaos.

Welcome to Mosh Pit Mayhem, a fast-paced brawler where fists fly, bodies collide, and the music never stops. Step into the pit and battle through waves of wild concertgoers in this no-holds-barred beatdown fueled by raw rhythm and real bands.

Every stage features three songs from real artists, each track a new round of pit-fueled madness. Survive the first two, and when the final song drops, the band dives into the pit themselves. Whether it’s trading blows with Las Vegas thrash titans 187, going head-to-head with the gritty bars of hardcore rap metal trio Hotbox, or brawling through the New York subway with Resistor, you’re in for the fight of your life.

Build your brawler your way, collect brass knuckles for boosted damage, lace up battle boots for some extra speed, and scavenge health pickups to keep the beat going. Need more staying power? Stock up on med kits, extra lives, and continues to stay in the fight and own the pit.

With over-the-top combos, devastating special attacks, and an adrenaline-pumping soundtrack, Mosh Pit Mayhem is a chaotic celebration of music, mayhem, and the raw power of the crowd.

No rules. No rails. Just you, the music, and the pit.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS on Steam Deck
  • Processor: AMD Zen 2 / 4 cores / 2.4 GHz – 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RDNA 2-based integrated graphics
  • Storage: 17 GB available space
